Behind the books

Thoughtful books.
Real-world experience.

Kite & Wonder is an independent children's learning imprint created by a sensory integration therapist and speech-language specialist.

Our books bring together professional experience working with children and families and a simple belief: the most meaningful learning often begins with everyday play.

We create practical, welcoming resources for grown-ups who want to make space for curiosity, movement, and connection.

Not more to do.
More ways to play.
